title: Synthetic toy coating experiment
text: This is a fictional demonstration, not a scientific study. In a toy experiment, coated sample A retains its artificial signal under heat while the uncoated toy control loses signal. Matched heating histories are required to compare these fictional samples.

title: Synthetic toy transport hypothesis
text: This invented example concerns two hypothetical interfaces. A reversible change under bias motivates a fictional ion-redistribution hypothesis. Reversing the applied bias and recording recovery would distinguish this toy mechanism from permanent damage.

title: Synthetic toy measurement control
text: This fictional control illustrates measurement drift. An unchanged reference sample is measured between experimental samples. A signal that changes equally in the reference and test sample indicates instrument drift in this invented example.
